findings.description: The bucket has no ACL restriction defined (comment indicates it is public) and lacks versioning or access logging, exposing stored data including sensitive customer files to unauthorized public access.
No server_side_encryption_configuration block is defined, meaning data stored in this bucket is not encrypted at rest by default.

findings.issue_category: sensitive data in public unencrypted bucket
findings.description: A customer master data file (customer-master.xlsx) is uploaded to the 'data' bucket, which is publicly accessible and has no encryption configured, directly exposing sensitive customer data to unauthorized access.
The financials bucket, likely containing sensitive financial data, has no server_side_encryption_configuration block, leaving data unencrypted at rest.
The operations bucket has no server_side_encryption_configuration block, leaving stored data unencrypted at rest.
The data_science bucket has no server_side_encryption_configuration block, leaving stored data unencrypted at rest despite having logging and versioning enabled.
